svg.title: Cut the head off and it becomes an encoder
svg.desc: A ResNet stack with a red dashed scissor cut between global average pooling and the classification head, leaving a 512-dimensional embedding that feeds a scatter cloud of fifty thousand indexed vectors where a query's three nearest neighbours are circled, beside a table comparing exact Flat, HNSW and IVF-PQ indexes at 2.1, 0.31 and 0.18 milliseconds and recall 1.000, 0.982 and 0.871, and a bottom strip where an image encoder and a text encoder converge on the same index.
svg.text: Cut the head off and it becomes an encoder
recall is what you are spending
you are buying speed and RAM with
images this week, text in Week 27
...and if the index does not fit in RAM? -> Week 27
